text:
nina: FYI we're seeing a spike of apiserver 503s in eu-south around 18:00 UTC. Controller-manager keeps restarting. Looks correlated with etcd leader churn.
ops-bot: ALERT: control-plane: apiserver 503 rate > 15% for 5m (eu-south). Pager: @nina, @harry.
harry: grabbing kube-system logs now. `kubectl get pods -n kube-system -o wide` shows api-server x3 CrashLoopBackOff, controller-manager restarting every ~45s.
leo: any recent config rollouts in eu-south? admission webhooks?
maria: no rollout. I see warning in etcd: `raft: leader changed: 3d2f -> 7a1c, took 142ms` repeated, then `server has reached maximum number of open connections`.
nina: interesting — could be file descriptor exhaustion on etcd nodes. Can someone check etcd node socket usage and iops? @infra-rotation do we have any noisy jobs in eu-south?
infra-rotation: checking scheduled maintenance and batch jobs. Nothing big reported. I do see sudden pod churn from the gpu-provisioner autoscaler: a bunch of GPU nodes are pending + kubelet restarts on new instances.
harry: paste from apiserver logs: `2026-03-18T18:01:12Z http: panic serving 10.0.2.34: read tcp 10.0.2.34:6443: read: connection reset by peer` then `500 GET /api/v1/nodes ... grpc: the client connection is closing`.
leo: controller-manager logs show `E0318 18:01:10 controller-runtime] failed to list *v1.Node: etcdserver: request timed out`. So etcd timeouts -> apiserver 5xx -> controllers restart.
maria: digging into etcd nodes. /var/log/etcd/etcd.log has repeated `fd_used: 1023/1024` warnings, then `too many open files`. ulimit is 1024 on two older hosts.
ops-bot: NOTE: recent CUDA driver update pushed to eu-south GPU AMI 6 hours ago (by infra-rotation).
infra-rotation: I rolled a small batch of GPU hosts with new AMI earlier today for kernel bug. The machines use an older etcd client library for node-exporter; they may have higher connection churn.
sara: could explain sockets staying open — kubelet / node-exporter opening many connections to metrics endpoints. If etcd hits fd limit it will reject heartbeat writes and leader election gets messy.
harry: snapshot of `ss -s` shows a lot of TIME_WAIT on etcd ports. iostat shows elevated avgqu-sz on etcd disks ~1.2. Not catastrophic but spiky.
leo: immediate mitigation ideas? Increase etcd FD limit and restart etcd nodes one at a time. Also temporarily increase apiserver toleration to avoid immediate pod evictions if it's availability related.
nina: agree. Plan: 1) infra-rotation will bump ulimit on etcd machines and rotate them one-by-one; 2) leo will patch apiserver to raise request-timeout and add circuit breaker to write-heavy endpoints for 1h; 3) harry will throttle GPU-AMI rollout and pause autoscaler.
infra-rotation: starting ulimit bump now (editing systemd unit LimitNOFILE=65536) and will restart etcd0. Will watch leader election. ETA ~12min per node.
maria: status: after restart of etcd0 leader election stabilized, apiserver error rate dropped to ~3%. controller-manager back to healthy. But one remaining etcd node still reporting fd near limit, patching next.
sara: for longer term: we need to add health checks for FD usage and tune kubelet/metrics exporters to reuse connections. Also consider moving heavy metrics traffic off etcd nodes (push gateway).
leo: also a follow-up: GPU provisioning churn contributed by AMI rollout — new nodes with older kubelet causing more ephemeral connections. For capacity we had to evict a few pods, causing controller stress. We should gate AMI rollouts by control plane health and prefer blue/green for regions low on capacity.
harry: opened infra ticket INFRA-2026 to add FD monitoring and automated alert at 80% usage.
ina: good. One more operational note: we hit a region constraint for A100 availability in eu-south this morning which forced autoscaler to spin up cross-zone instances, increasing network churn. Consider pre-warming spare dedicated capacity for high-demand windows. Cost vs reliability tradeoff.
infra-rotation: noted. I'll simulate a reserve pool and report estimated monthly cost delta.
leo: for immediate stability, I recommend throttling node provisioning parallelism to 2 and enabling kubelet keepalive tweaks on AMI. I'll make a short PR to infra images.
maria: controller-manager history shows no data-loss. All resources eventually converged. Postmortem: root cause = etcd FD exhaustion exacerbated by AMI-induced connection churn + cross-zone provisioning increasing load.
sara: I'll add runbook steps: `if apiserver_5xx_rate > 10% and etcd_fd_usage > 85% -> bump LimitNOFILE, rotate, pause autoscaler, and route traffic to fallback region`.
nina: thanks everyone. Reopening if we see reoccurrence. Action owners: infra-rotation (bump + reserves), leo (kubelet keepalive + PR), harry (monitoring alert INFRA-2026), sara (runbook).
ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: apiserver_503_rate dropped below threshold. Incident duration ~24m.
leo: quick note for sales/product slack: if we keep hitting eu-south capacity bursts we may need to advertise Dedicated reservations to high-cost customers — lower unit cost and predictable latency.
infra-rotation: report ETA for reserve cost calc by EOD.
harry: will follow up with graphs for control plane latency and fd usage.
nina: closing thread, will file postmortem doc tomorrow and link it here. :thumbsup:
